title: 13-Scene Renderer Paper Benchmark (paper-evidence lane)
purpose: Determine whether the frozen CGT rendering method delivers robust, paper-grade rendering acceleration across the standard 13-scene 3DGS benchmark, under a strong canonical baseline and full production rendering scope.
core_question: Does the already-frozen CGT mechanism generalize from the original three-scene evidence to the standard 13-scene 3DGS rendering benchmark, while preserving rendering quality and producing a meaningful full-frame speed advantage against a strong canonical baseline after all production costs are honestly accounted for?

method_freeze.rule: Read EXACT production config from authoritative F0/G1/G2/G3 artifacts. Do NOT infer from the prompt. If any scientifically material F0 config is ambiguous, STOP with BLOCKED_F0_METHOD_IDENTITY.

no_retuning.rule: The EXACT SAME production CGT method must run on all 13 scenes. Ablations later, clearly separated.

baselines.A_same_workload_canonical: exact canonical reference corresponding to F0/CGT work-unit semantics; measures algorithmic/system translation under matched work; reported separately for mechanism analysis.
baselines.B_strong_canonical_renderer: strong production canonical baseline chosen BEFORE seeing PAPER13 CGT performance; prevents inflated speedup from a weak baseline; MAIN paper headline prioritizes Baseline B for end-to-end rendering claims.
baselines.strong_baseline_selection: per-scene tile16 vs tile32, chosen by faster canonical runtime using ONLY canonical measurements (no CGT influence); record baseline_tile_selected; also compute a globally frozen canonical tile via 13-scene geomean runtime.

per_scene: bake invariant activations/precomputation when canonical legitimately allows
inference_protocol.rule: 100 complete test-set rendering passes if computationally feasible; else preserve enough reps for stable stats and document deviation. No single-frame best-case as main result.

build_vs_render.T_build: one-time: coefficient fitting + representation construction + certificate construction + metadata + host/device transfer before inference
build_vs_render.N_break_even: ceil(T_build/(T_canonical_frame - T_CGT_frame)) when CGT frame faster; else report no break-even
build_vs_render.rule: Do not hide build time. Primary paper metric = E2E steady-state frame, NOT fused inner kernel alone.

e2e_frame_scope: include all per-frame costs: camera-dependent setup, query/tile prep, certificate dispatch if per-frame, CGT fast path, fallback path, composition, synchronization, required memory movement. Explicit timing DAG. Also report F0-equivalent MIXED_FORWARD labeled clearly (not end-to-end).

correctness.rule: Do not use GT similarity to conceal canonical mismatch.

quality_gates.rule: |delta PSNR|<=0.15 dB and |delta SSIM|<=0.005 vs canonical; LPIPS reported if available; retain F0 correctness tolerance; do not lower gates after results.

certificate_stats.rule: No scene-level average may hide a bad scene.

speedup_tiers.rule: evidence tiers, not excuses to change method. Headline = GEOMETRIC MEAN of per-scene E2E speedups vs strong canonical baseline. Do not use ratio-of-pooled-times as only headline.

heterogeneity: analyze scenes where CGT slower/less beneficial; correlate speedup with gaussian count, tile occupancy, safe/fallback fraction, avg intersections/tile, certificate behavior, tile workload distribution, resolution, G1/G3 compressibility. Do not hide bicycle-like cases.

ablations.reason: one difficult Mip-NeRF360, one Tanks&Temples, one Deep Blending; not chosen for favorable results
ablations.A_rank: R=4,8,16 fixed semantics; report E2E frame, mixed-forward, safe/fallback fraction, max_abs, delta PSNR, memory; analysis only
ablations.B_cert_fallback: A frozen certified mixed CGT / B CGT fast path w/o fallback+certified dispatch where meaningful / C canonical; show why certification/fallback necessary
ablations.C_fused_translation: reference/unfused CGT vs fused CUDA CGT vs canonical; separate representation advantage from GPU implementation advantage

related_work: separate literature table (Faster-GS, TensorGS, TileGS, LocoGS, + fresh prior-art); label PUBLISHED / NOT APPLES-TO-APPLES; never merge cross-hardware into authoritative table.
same_hw_reproduction: optional, not blocking; attempt ONE strong external renderer baseline on same A100 cohort if readily reproducible; if blocked, published comparison only.

forbidden: exact rendering if fallback/approximation do not justify
claim_discipline.safe_provisional_claim: CGT exploits certifiable tile-local compressibility in Gaussian rendering and dispatches certified work to a fused structured fast path while retaining canonical fallback for uncertified work.

training_boundary: G5/TI0 negatives NOT in main 13-scene table; PAPER13_TRAINING_BOUNDARY.md records native training failed at G5 and canonical-training integration failed at TI0; define CGT as rendering representation not training primitive.

main_benchmark_stop_rules.correctness_fail: do not modify CGT inside PAPER13; record scene failure; continue other scenes only if scientifically valid and preserve the failure
main_benchmark_stop_rules.impl_bug: bugfix allowed only if root cause documented, no algorithm/gate changed, all affected scene results invalidated and rerun, old outputs archived superseded

gpu_allocation: paper timing on clean/exclusive A100; paired scene authoritative comparison must not share GPU; guarded launch; no foreign-process contamination.
interim_status_after_P0: immediately return: how many of 13 have valid checkpoints/data, which missing, which need canonical training, estimated GPU work UNITS (not time), whether frozen F0 CGT can ingest all source schemas, any hard blocker; then continue automatically if no scientific blocker.
rule: This is NOT a training verdict. Do not invent a new method. Do not rescue failed scenes. Turn the existing CGT result into paper-grade evidence.
